name: Fire Touch
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You surround your hand in a shimmering orange and yellow flame. You must succeed on a melee touch attack to strike a target. The subject takes 1d4 points of fire damage. This spell does not light combustibles on fire.
